## Definition of Done (`docs/coding-standards.md` §13)

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` passed cleanly (output attached).
- [ ] New domain logic covered by tests; tests verified to fail when code is broken.
- [ ] Database changes: migration applied on dev, types regenerated, `db:smoke` green, `data-model.md` updated.
- [ ] UI changes: checked on mobile (390 px) and laptop (1366 px), light & dark themes, keyboard navigation.
- [ ] Behavior changes: `docs/spec.md` and/or `docs/algorithms.md` updated.
- [ ] Out-of-scope changes explicitly named and separated.
- [ ] Both authors understand and can explain every line.
